remarks: Stately custom-built Traditional home situated on a beautifully landscaped lot with mature greenery and a paved driveway leading to an attached 2-car garage featuring a 3rd door for extra utility. The open-concept main level features dramatic soaring cathedral ceilings, rich hardwood flooring, and abundant natural light from large sunlit windows and arched architectural accents. A spacious great room flows seamlessly into formal and informal dining areas, highlighted by custom built-in cabinetry and a cozy gas fireplace centerpiece. The gourmet kitchen is designed for entertaining, complete with solid wood cabinetry, granite countertops, a central island with seating, double wall ovens, a gas cooktop, and a dedicated wet bar area with a built-in wine cooler. Conveniently located on the main floor, you will also find a functional pantry/laundry room and direct access to the garage, as well as a half bath. Outdoor living spaces abound, including an expansive Trex deck off the main level and an enclosed, screened-in Sun Room with ceiling fans for year-round relaxation. The generous main-floor primary suite features plush carpeting, a walk-in closet, and direct sliding glass door access to the outdoor Sun Room. The luxurious en-suite bathroom boasts a dual-sink vanity, tile flooring, a glass-enclosed walk-in shower, and a large deep soaking tub with surrounding tile.There is also a 2nd bedroom on the main floor currently used as office space. The upper level offers two spacious bedrooms connected by a beautiful exterior deck overlooking the tranquil creek, along with a full bathroom & loft area. Downstairs, the basement is ready to be finished to your personal vision, with a finished full bath already in place—the possibilities are truly endless! Additional features include Heated floors in the basement & 1st floor with 6-zone heating plus forced air with central A/C, built-in surround sound system, and a quick walk to Holiday Valley Resort or everything the Village of Ellicottville has to offer. Meticulously maintained and move-in ready, this home offers exceptional craftsmanship and pride of ownership throughout.
